tools.name: check_trademark
tools.description: Check whether a name is taken as a trademark in the US, EU and Israeli registers. Returns one of three verdicts (exact_live_mark, similar_live_marks, no_live_match), or not_checked when no register in the check has been read yet, with the marks behind it, how each matched, and when each register was

tools.name: search_trademarks
tools.description: Ranked live marks that share a query's spelling or sound, across the US, EU and Israeli registers.
